main_concerns.concern: bundle 受 bounded-read 限制，loom_runtime.py 在 60kB 处截断，Prism 无法直接目视 1145-1190 行；外部项目存在性的原始探针回执未出现在 bundle 中，只能依赖验证回执间接推断；负向测试仅覆盖 origin_type 未声明场景，未覆盖伪造 independent_external_project 的对抗场景。

Self-referential evidence loop: evidence-supplement.json is generated by the same system under review. Its core claims (file existence, external project independence, test passes) can only be verified by reading the pointed-to files, which are inaccessible. File existence probes are weak validation — external files may exist but be empty, stubbed, or populated by the same RedCap pipeline. The key facts list describes zero content-level validation of external project files (e.g., do external results contain diverse provider outputs? Realistic failure patterns? Non-trivial data volume?).

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: 若希望将 confidence 提升至 high：1) 在下一轮 bundle 中完整包含 loom_runtime.py 的 1031-1228 区间；2) 附加外部项目根目录及三个关键证据文件的原始 ls/stat 探针回执；3) 补充一个伪造 independent_external_project 并提供虚假 preexisting_project_evidence_refs 的对抗样本，验证门禁仍拒绝。

Provide one of: (1) content snippets or hashes from key external project files proving diverse provider outputs and non-trivial data; (2) external project creation timestamp or git history proving independence from current RedCap evidence supplement generation; (3) grant Prism reviewer direct read access to authorized paths (especially evidence-supplement.json, ls-006-* receipt files, loom_runtime.py relevant lines) for independent verification. If none are feasible, LS-006 concern should remain unresolved.
